descriptions.zh: 我们已经得到了誊录仪——一件外星文物——的最后已知坐标，其位于一个我们从未探测到的恒星系。虽然我们还不清楚这件文物的意义，但是据说它蕴含巨大的能量。
descriptions.en: We have uncovered the last known location of the Rubricator, an ancient alien artifact, in a previously uncharted system. Though we do not yet know its purpose, it is rumored to hold great power.
